title: rulecad rule set
description: Shared facts (a printer, a screw size, a part's datasheet), each with where it comes from.

part.description: What sort of part it describes (motor, bearing, thread): its names come from vocabulary.json, and cad rules check holds it to them

interface.description: Which rule is which shared name in vocabulary.json, for a set that keeps its own names

variants.description: A maker's part numbers for this part, each the rules that differ: { "17HS4401": { "kind", "source", "values": { "body_length": 40 } } }

circuit.description: A published board's circuit (parts, pads, nets, planes, outline), read by cad clone, for @rulecad/pcb's clone()

value.description: A number, an expression, text, or a list of numbers or expressions in the rule's one unit (the lengths a screw is sold in)

kind.description: How far to trust it, most to least: measured, spec, community, default, derived, estimate

licence.description: The source's licence, when the value was read off someone else's work (cad measure, cad clone)
